text: Acceptance capture is now fail-closed and reproducible. real-site-smoke.sh records shell-escaped argv and exit codes, captures structured array JSON immediately after acceptance, bounds queue/accounting polling, requires both array accounting rows, emits byte-count/SHA-256 manifest.tsv, and returns 75 for incomplete terminal evidence. Deterministic fake-Slurm tests cover read-only discovery, accepted completion, incomplete accounting, and sbatch rejection while re-hashing every manifest entry. Current-tree gate is green: bash syntax, harness test, formatting, 128 tests on Scala 3.3.8, 128 on Scala 3.8.4, and worker packageBin on both. External P5 gates remain unchanged: second actual Slurm major family and authenticated unprivileged-site capture.
